mcp:tool-listener.name: screen-name
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Screens a person or company name against the watch lists (sanctions, foreign PEPs and the bank's own list of counterparties to watch). Each hit says which list, whether the name matched exactly or only partially, and whether the birth date matches (true / false / "unknown"). A partial match with a different birth date is usually a different person. Returns an empty hits list when nothing matches.

mcp:tool-listener.name: search-news
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Searches news articles that mention a person or company name. Returns date, source, title and body for each. An article about someone with the same name is not necessarily about this customer: compare age, address and occupation before drawing any conclusion.

db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM news ORDER BY published_on DESC

mcp:tool-listener.name: check-parties
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Screens several people or companies at once: for each party, the watch-list hits (as screen-name returns them) and the news articles that mention it (as search-news returns them). Use this to check a customer and the counterparties of their notable transactions in one call.

db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM news ORDER BY published_on DESC
